mn42:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn42:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena Verañjakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā Sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti kenacid-eva karaṇīyena.
mn42:2.3: Samaṇo khalu kho Gotamo Sakyaputto Sakyakulā pabbajito Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme;
mn42:2.4: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
mn42:2.5: Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
mn42:2.6: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
mn42:2.7: So dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
mn42:2.8: Sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.
mn42:3.1: Atha kho Verañjakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā appekacce Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, appekacce Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ appekacce yena Bhagavā ten' añjalim-paṇāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, app-ekacce Bhagavato santike nāmagottaṃ sāvetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, app-ekacce tuṇhībhūtā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho Verañjakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā Bhagavantaṃ etad-avocuṃ:
mn42:4.1: Ko nu kho bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti;
mn42:4.2: ko pana bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti. --
mn42:5.1: Adhammacariyā-visamacariyāhetu kho gahapatayo evam-idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti;
mn42:5.2: dhammacariyā-samacariyāhetu kho gahapatayo evam-idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti. --
mn42:6.1: Na kho mayaṃ imassa bhoto Gotamassa saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāma;
mn42:6.2: sādhu no bhavaṇGotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā mayaṃ imassa bhoto Gotamassa saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājāneyyāmāti. --
mn42:6.3: Tena hi gahapatayo suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmīti.
mn42:6.4: -Evaṃ bho ti kho Verañjakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
